Why NEWRONIQ Academy?

Beyond Learning to Code

Writing code is only one part of software engineering. Building dependable applications requires sound design, testing, security, debugging and deployment practices.

Our programme focuses on helping learners understand how these responsibilities fit together in real software development.

Practical Engineering

Apply concepts through guided development exercises and realistic engineering scenarios.

AI-Assisted Development

Learn to use AI coding assistants while reviewing, testing and validating their output.

Production Mindset

Understand reliability, security, maintainability and operational requirements from the beginning.

What You'll Learn

Java & Backend Engineering

  • Core Java and object-oriented design
  • Spring Boot and REST APIs
  • Databases and enterprise integration

Software Quality & Security

  • Unit and integration testing
  • Debugging, code reviews and refactoring
  • API security, error handling and clean code

Cloud & DevOps Fundamentals

  • Git and collaborative development
  • Docker and CI/CD pipelines
  • Cloud deployment concepts using AWS or Azure

AI-Assisted Software Engineering

  • AI-supported code generation
  • Reviewing and correcting generated code
  • Testing, security and responsible AI usage

How You'll Learn

Learn. Build. Review. Improve.

  1. 01 — Understand

    Learn engineering concepts and how they are applied.

  2. 02 — Build

    Implement features through structured, hands-on exercises.

  3. 03 — Review

    Analyse code quality, identify defects and improve implementations.

  4. 04 — Deliver

    Practise testing, packaging and deployment using modern development tools.

Practical Learning Experience

Apply What You Learn

The programme is designed around a guided software application, allowing learners to practise:

  • Designing and implementing REST APIs.
  • Integrating application and database components.
  • Writing and running automated tests.
  • Reviewing and improving AI-generated code.
  • Managing code using Git.
  • Understanding build pipelines and cloud deployment.

Who Is This For?

Designed for Aspiring Software Engineers

Computer Science & Engineering Graduates

Develop practical software engineering skills beyond academic assignments.

Early-Career Developers

Strengthen backend development, testing and delivery practices.

Developers Exploring AI-Assisted Engineering

Learn to use AI coding tools responsibly without losing engineering fundamentals.

What You'll Work Towards

Skills That Extend Beyond Writing Code

By the end of the learning activities, participants should be better equipped to:

  • Build and explain a structured backend application.
  • Write, test and debug Java services.
  • Evaluate AI-generated code critically.
  • Understand common cloud deployment workflows.
  • Explain architectural and engineering decisions.
